top_signals.title: Volvo folds powertrain repairs into its service contract
top_signals.summary:
Volvo Trucks North America launched the Silver Service Contract at ATA's Management Conference, adding powertrain repair coverage to its connected Blue maintenance plan.

The post Volvo folds powertrain repairs into its service contract appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: New Oil Fields Should Have to Build the Carbon Storage Market
top_signals.summary: The debate over new oil and gas fields usually ends in a familiar deadlock. Industry argues that production will still be needed for decades, supports jobs and reduces dependence on imports. Climate campaigners respond that every new field locks in emissions incompatible with net zero. Both sides then discuss carbon capture and storage as an afterthought: either a technological excuse for continued extraction or a costly public project unrelated to the licence being approved.
